title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Agentic Era: Tradition, Present, and Prospect
abstract: arXiv:2611.30181v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) couples frozen language models with external, updatable knowledge, so that generation is grounded in retrieved evidence rather than in parametric memory alone. This work maps RAG in the agentic era by joining them on a single lifecycle axis, from offline indexing through pre-retrieval, retrieval, post-retrieval, and orchestration over these stages. It treats indexing and orchestration as first-class components and agentic workflows as a paradigm of their own, and it covers the agentic work that has appeared since those reviews. Beyond these components, it covers evaluation, applications, and the questions that remain open for future exploration. From tradition to present and beyond, this work systematically reviews RAG from a perspective of the agentic era.

translated_title: 智能体时代的检索增强生成：传统、现状与展望
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）将冻结的语言模型与外部可更新的知识相结合，使生成过程以检索到的证据为基础，而不再仅仅依赖参数化记忆。本工作通过将各阶段统一到单一的生命周期轴上——从离线索引，到检索前、检索、检索后，以及对这些阶段的编排——勾勒了智能体时代的RAG图景。它将索引与编排视为一等组件，将智能体工作流作为一种独立范式加以论述，并涵盖了此前综述之后出现的智能体相关工作。除上述组件外，本工作还涵盖了评估、应用以及未来探索中尚待解决的研究问题。从传统到当下乃至未来，本工作从智能体时代的视角对RAG进行了系统性综述。
tldr: 该论文从智能体时代视角出发，沿着统一的生命周期轴（离线索引、检索前、检索、检索后与编排）系统综述了RAG的最新进展，并首次将索引与编排作为一等组件、将智能体工作流作为独立范式加以梳理，同时讨论了评估、应用与未来开放问题。
en_tdlr: This work systematically reviews RAG from the agentic era perspective, organizing it along a unified lifecycle axis (offline indexing, pre-retrieval, retrieval, post-retrieval, and orchestration), treating indexing and orchestration as first-class components and agentic workflows as a distinct paradigm, while also covering evaluation, applications, and open questions for future research.
